bugs.error_message: Don't have a wallet? Create one link on /connect validates form instead of navigating to wallet signup
bugs.root_cause: /wallet had beforeLoad: requireAuth which redirected unauthenticated users back to /connect; create-wallet link inside form triggered onBlur validation on click
bugs.fix: Removed requireAuth from /wallet (WalletShell already shows AuthForms for guests); moved create-wallet link outside the connect form; set form validation to onSubmit only; onMouseDown preventDefault on link to stop blur re-render swallowing first click
